milestones.label: Applications open for the 2027/28 HKPFS
milestones.source_text: PolyU's HKPFS page (a participating university) says the application period starts on 1 September 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline for the 2027/28 HKPFS
milestones.time_text: 12:00 noon Hong Kong time for the initial application to the Research Grants Council; 23:59 for the full university application
milestones.source_text: HKU and PolyU pages (university sources) both give 1 December 2026 for the initial and full applications.

milestones.label: Results announced by the Research Grants Council
milestones.source_text: PolyU's page says the RGC announces results in April to May 2027.
